text_block_list.text:
The Kikuka Sho has ended. The cheers of 
the crowd celebrate only Seiun Sky and 
Special Week. King Halo faces reality 
head-on.

"...I wasn't acknowledged. I'm not 
first-rate. As King Halo weakly lets those 
words slip, encouraging her are Kawakami 
Princess, a few other Umamusume, and..."

He was the Trainer who had watched over 
her all this time. King Halo rested her 
face against his shoulder. Just for a 
little while, until her tears stopped 
flowing.

And encouraged by her Trainer, she set out 
on a path that wasn't just about winning 
someone's approval— she began aiming for 
"first-class in her own way."
